name: TalentLMS
description_en:
TalentLMS is a cloud LMS for employee, partner and customer training. It organizes courses and learning paths, supports audience-specific portals and offers AI-assisted content and skills tools.

TalentLibrary course content, TalentCraft AI credits and other products in the same company family should be separated from the base LMS. The appropriate plan depends on users, branches, content and support needs.
description_zh:
TalentLMS 是用于员工、伙伴及客户培训的云 LMS，可组织课程和学习路径、提供分人群门户，并有 AI 内容及技能工具。

TalentLibrary 课程内容、TalentCraft AI credits 和同公司其他产品需与基础 LMS 区分。套餐应按用户、分支、内容及支持需求选择。

core_features.explanation_en: Organize different training audiences with centralized administration.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在集中管理下组织不同培训人群。

core_features.explanation_en: TalentCraft and related AI features help create course material for review.
core_features.explanation_zh: TalentCraft 等 AI 功能辅助生成待审核教材。

core_features.explanation_en: Eligible Pro usage can meter monthly unique logins and overage.
core_features.explanation_zh: 符合条件的 Pro 按每月独立登录及超额计量。

sources.research_notes_en: Read user-band/cadence options, flexible Pro unique-user overage, one-time TalentCraft credits and promotional Learning Playground caveat. Free FAQ confirms no time limit, up to five users and ten courses.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The homepage describes separate portals for employees, partners or customers within a centralized platform, alongside course and assessment creation and learner progress analysis. TalentLibrary and third-party course providers are content offerings; TalentCards, eFront and TalentHR are separately named products. A family navigation menu does not make them all part of one subscription.
sections.zh: 首页介绍在集中平台内为员工、伙伴或客户建立独立门户，以及课程考核创作和进展分析。TalentLibrary 与第三方课程方属于内容产品；TalentCards、eFront、TalentHR 是另外命名的产品。家族导航菜单不意味着同一次订阅包含全部。

sections.title_en: Example: onboard a partner sales team
sections.title_zh: 示例：培训伙伴销售团队
sections.en: Prepare a short product course, assign it to a pilot audience and define a completion check. Use learner and supervisor accounts to verify permissions and reporting, then inspect a failed assessment or interrupted session. If adding ready-made content, verify that its license, audience and examples match the training need. This is a proposed workflow and was not run.
sections.zh: 准备产品短课，分配给试点人群并定义完成检查。使用学员和主管账户核对权限报告，再检查测验失败或会话中断。加入现成内容时，需确认许可、人群和示例适合培训目标。本例未实际运行。

sections.title_en: User bands, flexible limits and AI allowances
sections.title_zh: 用户档位、弹性上限及 AI 额度
sections.en: The price page lists Core/Grow/Pro and asks for a user band and billing cadence; the fetched default Core block shows $119/month, but toggle state and optional content affect the quote, so no universal normalized amount is stored. Flexible user limits are described as unique monthly logins, with per-user overage, available up to 500 users on Pro. Core lists one branch and a one-time 5,000 TalentCraft AI credits; a one-time grant is not a monthly refill. Learning Playground is explicitly promotional and may move to a higher plan.
sections.zh: 定价页列 Core/Grow/Pro，并要求选择用户档位和结算周期；抓取默认 Core 块显示每月 119 美元，但切换状态和可选内容会影响报价，因此不存通用标准金额。弹性上限按每月独立登录用户计算，超额按人计费，在 Pro 最多支持 500 用户。Core 列一个分支及一次性 5,000 TalentCraft AI credits；一次赠送并非每月补充。Learning Playground 明确为促销权益，可能移到更高套餐。

sections.en: The pricing page documents an ongoing Free plan for up to five users and ten courses, without a time limit. Start there with an administrator and a sample course. Test identity synchronization, completion reports and branch isolation for the intended audience. TalentLMS can fit ongoing business training; LMS activity is not proof of skill acquisition. Self-hosting, source licensing, retention and restoration guarantees were not verified.
sections.zh: 定价页明确提供不限使用期限的 Free，最多五名用户和十门课程。可从该套餐、管理员和样例课程开始。按目标人群测试身份同步、完成报告及分支隔离。它可用于持续业务培训，但 LMS 活动不能证明技能获得。自托管、源码许可、保留和恢复保证未核实。
